claims.configuration: Path/default/environment precedence/role isolation/non-echo assertions only; config does not read deployment files
claims.sourceFD: real one-selected-open success plus mocked close-count failures, stale-stat overflow/read-error/non-file; no process-wide FD census
claims.sourceNoListener: forbidden createServer/netServer/store/runtime candidate mocks + owned store paths unchanged/absent; instrumented attempt boundary
claims.captures: inert deeply frozen handles/private registry; no-reread and original pre-await Read tuple; actual existing capture/compile delegation
claims.publicPrivacy: exact package exports/private Snapshot and json-value-equality public-entry scans; lifecycle facet freeze/keys/privacy
claims.credential: Tokens remain private captures; direct opaque provenance identities commit to contents, not entropy proof

observations: Assertion-only callbacks emit no new structured observation schema. Auditing must not invent per-request/FD/HTTP telemetry from passing titles. In-callback table iterations are source-derived, not separate Vitest callbacks.
collectorBarrier: fresh-build and root accepted actual build inventory BEFORE ANY test collection/import
